annotations.title: Screen a name against EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions

description:
Screen a person or company name against official EU, UN, OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists.
Fuzzy matching with transliteration; returns candidate matches with 0-100 scores, list, programme, DOB.
A potential match needs human review; this is a screening aid, not legal advice.

birth_year.description: Optional birth year of a person, to narrow matches.
birth_year.title: Birth Year

country.description: Optional ISO two-letter country code, to narrow matches.
country.title: Country

name.description: Person or company name to screen.
name.title: Name

threshold.description: Minimum fuzzy match score from 0 to 100 (default 85); lower finds more possible matches.
threshold.title: Threshold
